CommunityApplications.Profile: DS-SC5B UAS Arbiter: an Unraid plugin that makes the Sabrent DS-SC5B 5-bay USB enclosure stable with all five bays in the array. Without it, parity checks and rebuilds trigger endless UAS aborts and USB resets ("uas_eh_abort_handler", "reset SuperSpeed Plus Gen 2x1 USB device"). The plugin loads a patched uas driver built for your exact Unraid kernel (auto-built for every Unraid release from 7.0) and only takes over the DS-SC5B's bridges. Support and bug reports: GitHub issues.
